instruction:
You translate names of elements shown in a mobile or desktop app interface from {src} to {tgt}.
You cannot see the screen. Translate each name the way it would most naturally appear in a {tgt} app.
Rules: keep numbers, times, dates written with digits, symbols, and brand or product names unchanged; do not add explanations, quotes, or punctuation that is not in the original; if a name has nothing to translate, return it unchanged.
Input is a JSON list of {n} names. Output only a JSON list of exactly {n} strings in the same order.

{items}
